newsitem.title: USA: Delmarva Power extends preferred offer.
newsitem.headline: Delmarva Power extends preferred offer.

text.p: Delmarva Power & Light Co said Wednesday it has extended its offer to purchase its preferred stock for cash to October 11 to allow for complete distribution of the supplement.
The offer dated August 21 was scheduled to expire September 20. It said the prices offered remain unchanged.
A preliminary count showed that the following shares had been tendered in connection with the offer as of October 1:
-- 8,918 shares of the 3.70 percent preferred stock ($100 par value), representing 17.8 percent of those outstanding
-- 18,149 shares of the four percent preferred stock ($100 par value), representing 45.4 percent of those outstanding
-- 23,572 shares of the 4.20 percent preferred stock ($100 par value), representing 47.1 percent of those outstanding
-- 19,354 shares of the 4.28 percent preferred stock ($100 par value), representing 38.7 percent of those outstanding
-- 29,641 shares of the 4.56 percent preferred stock ($100 par value), representing 59.3 percent of those outstanding
-- 30,422 shares of the five percent preferred stock ($100 par value), representing 38.0 percent of those outstanding
-- 165,000 shares of the 6-3/4 percent preferred stock ($100 par value), representing 82.5 percent of those outstanding
-- 1,268,716 shares of the 7-3/4 percent preferred stock $25 par, representing 79.3 percent of those outstanding
-- 9,650 shares of the adjustable rate preferred stock, Series A, $100 par value, representing 6.0 percent of those outstanding.
